aiDescriptions.n: No AI description generation. Universe object descriptions are written by hand in the Information Design Tool.

bulkMetadata.n: The Semantic Layer Java SDK ships with the BI client tools. Third-party catalog bridges use it to read and write .unx universes. No first-party bulk tool seen.

autoClassify.n: No automatic classification or PII tagging. Sensitivity is handled with manual security profiles.

sampleValues.n: No NL-to-SQL literal matching. Universe objects have lists of values for query prompts only.

queryHistory.n: Data Federation Administration Tool browses executed queries for monitoring. Any mining for joins or metrics is DIY.

lineage.n: No lineage view inside BI found. Talend Data Catalog, a separate product, imports universes (.unx) with transformation lineage.

evals.n: No NL-to-SQL, so no accuracy tests or feedback loop.

vendors.enrichHowTo: The Semantic Layer Java SDK ships with the BI client tools and reads universes (.unx). Third-party catalog bridges use it to import and export universe metadata.

aiDescriptions.n: Enable for AI generates a dataset description and a description per column from column name and sample values. Editable. Since March 2025.

bulkMetadata.n: Since June 2026, download an agent's tuning file (JSON) with column descriptions and custom instructions, and upload it to another agent.

sampleValues.n: Agent auto complete lists matching columns and attribute elements as users type, so a typed value picks the exact element.

lineage.n: Components and Dependents views show object-level links between reports, attributes, metrics and tables. No column-level lineage view documented.

evals.n: Thumbs feedback and reasons are stored in Platform Analytics tables. Clarifications become per-user learnings. No eval runner or shared verified examples seen.

vendors.enrichHowTo: Enable the dataset for AI in Workstation or Library to generate dataset and column descriptions. Edit them in the agent data panel, then download the agent tuning file (JSON) to reuse column descriptions in other agents.

aiDescriptions.n: Generates descriptions for a data product, its datasets and fields from names and native types. Premium tiers, English only, editable.

bulkMetadata.n: Data sets API PATCH /api/v1/data-sets/{id} updates dataset metadata. Glossaries API can import terms. No API for vocabulary or logical model.

autoClassify.n: Each field gets a semantic type when over 40% of values match. Detected types such as email or national ID can flag sensitive data.

sampleValues.n: Business logic vocabulary adds alternative names for fields and values and names for coded values. Logical model sets which fields are value searchable.

queryHistory.n: Default logical model learns from charts users add or edit. Precedents are per user and unavailable once business logic is on.

lineage.n: Field-level lineage and impact analysis for cataloged data across apps, scripts and datasets. Also available through the Lineage graphs API.

evals.n: Feedback and questions are logged for audit admins via the Natural Language API; docs point to manual model fixes.

vendors.enrichHowTo: Write dataset descriptions and tags with PATCH /api/v1/data-sets/{id} in the Data sets API, and load business terms with the Glossaries API import. Insight Advisor synonyms are edited by hand in each app's Vocabulary, because the REST API list has no vocabulary or logical model endpoint.

aiDescriptions.n: Catalog Descriptions drafts dataset descriptions. Semantic Modeler Assistant suggests names and writes presentation table and column descriptions.

bulkMetadata.n: Export the data model index to CSV in Console, edit synonyms, AI Descriptions and index type, and import it. Last import wins per column.

autoClassify.n: Dataset profiling detects semantic types and recommends enrichments. Sensitive columns are flagged by hand with the DataSecurity setting.

sampleValues.n: Index type Index covers metadata and data values for dimension columns. Index Metadata Only keeps values out, for sensitive columns.

queryHistory.n: Usage Tracking logs logical and physical queries to a database you specify. Analyzing it is up to the team.

lineage.n: Semantic Modeler lineage viewer and Export Lineage CSV map presentation columns to logical and physical columns. Scope is the semantic model.

evals.n: AI Assistant feedback is written to OCI logs with category and details. Docs do not say it improves future answers.

vendors.enrichHowTo: In Console, open Search Index, select the data model and Export a CSV. Fill the Synonyms and AI Description columns, then Import it. Indexing restarts on import, and the file also moves AI-ready metadata between environments.

notes.topic: Oracle AI Descriptions are written by hand
notes.text: In Oracle Analytics, an AI Description is a column field that you write to give the AI Assistant business context such as units or scale. It is separate from the generative features that draft dataset and presentation descriptions.

notes.topic: Qlik business logic turns off precedent learning
notes.text: When business logic is enabled in a Qlik app, precedent-based learning is disabled for that app, so Insight Advisor relies on the logical model and vocabulary you maintain.
